minimum_matching =: 3 : 0
    'rows columns' =. $y
    if. (rows=0)+.columns=0 do. 0 2$0 return. end.
    transposed =. rows>columns
    matrix =. y
    if. transposed do. matrix =. |:matrix end.
    'rows columns' =. $matrix
    u =. (rows+1)$0.0
    v =. (columns+1)$0.0
    matched =. previous =. (columns+1)$0
    for_row. 1+i.rows do.
        matched =. row 0}matched
        column =. 0
        distances =. (columns+1)$_
        used =. (columns+1)$0
        while. 1 do.
            used =. 1 column}used
            currentrow =. column{matched
            delta =. _
            following =. 0
            for_candidate. 1+i.columns do.
                if. -.candidate{used do.
                    reduced =. (((<(currentrow-1),candidate-1){matrix)-currentrow{u)-candidate{v
                    if. reduced<candidate{distances do.
                        distances =. reduced candidate}distances
                        previous =. column candidate}previous
                    end.
                    if. (candidate{distances)<delta do.
                        delta =. candidate{distances
                        following =. candidate
                    end.
                end.
            end.
            for_candidate. i.columns+1 do.
                if. candidate{used do.
                    index =. candidate{matched
                    u =. ((index{u)+delta)index}u
                    v =. ((candidate{v)-delta)candidate}v
                else. distances =. ((candidate{distances)-delta)candidate}distances end.
            end.
            column =. following
            if. 0=column{matched do. break. end.
        end.
        while. column~:0 do.
            following =. column{previous
            matched =. (following{matched)column}matched
            column =. following
        end.
    end.
    result =. 0 2$0
    for_column. 1+i.columns do.
        row =. column{matched
        if. row>0 do.
            if. transposed do. result =. result,(column-1),row-1
            else. result =. result,(row-1),column-1 end.
        end.
    end.
    (/:result){result
)
optimal_assignment =: 4 : 0
    usable =. x
    costs =. y
    'rows columns' =. $costs
    if. (rows=0)+.(columns=0)+.-.+./,usable do. 0 2$0 return. end.
    largest =. >./(,usable)#,costs
    penalty =. ((rows<.columns)+1)*((1.0>.largest)+1.0)
    matrix =. costs
    matrix =. penalty(I.-.,usable)},matrix
    matrix =. (rows,columns)$matrix
    result =. 0 2$0
    for_pair. minimum_matching matrix do.
        if. (<pair){usable do. result =. result,pair end.
    end.
    result
)

ospa =: 3 : 0
    'first second cutoff' =. y
    if. ((#first)=0)*.(#second)=0 do. 0.0 return. end.
    if. ((#first)=0)+.(#second)=0 do. cutoff return. end.
    smaller =. first
    larger =. second
    if. (#first)>#second do. smaller =. second [ larger =. first end.
    costs =. ((#smaller),#larger)$0.0
    for_i. i.#smaller do.
        for_j. i.#larger do.
            clipped =. cutoff<.(i{smaller)distance j{larger
            costs =. (clipped*clipped)(<i,j)}costs
        end.
    end.
    total =. 0.0
    for_pair. minimum_matching costs do. total =. total+(<pair){costs end.
    %:(total+(cutoff*cutoff)*((#larger)-#smaller))%#larger
)
continuity =: 3 : 0
    covered =. groups =. swaps =. 0
    previous_label =. delay =. _1
    previous_covered =. 0
    for_i. i.#y do.
        label =. i{y
        if. label<0 do. previous_covered =. 0 else.
            covered =. covered+1
            if. delay<0 do. delay =. i end.
            if. -.previous_covered do. groups =. groups+1 end.
            if. (previous_label>:0)*.previous_label~:label do. swaps =. swaps+1 end.
            previous_label =. label
            previous_covered =. 1
        end.
    end.
    covered,(0>.groups-1),swaps,delay
)

imm_step =: 3 : 0
    'record interval measurement' =. y
    'oldmodels mu' =. record
    predicted =. i.0
    for_j. i.2 do.
        value =. (((<0,j){IMMTransition)*0{mu)+((<1,j){IMMTransition)*1{mu
        predicted =. predicted,value
    end.
    firststate =. 2{::0{::oldmodels
    secondstate =. 2{::1{::oldmodels
    firstcov =. 3{::0{::oldmodels
    secondcov =. 3{::1{::oldmodels
    models =. 0$a:
    likelihoods =. i.0
    for_j. i.2 do.
        w1 =. (((<0,j){IMMTransition)*0{mu)%j{predicted
        w2 =. (((<1,j){IMMTransition)*1{mu)%j{predicted
        mixed =. (w1*firststate)+w2*secondstate
        covariance =. 4 4$0.0
        for_r. i.4 do.
            for_s. i.4 do.
                d1r =. (r{firststate)-r{mixed
                d1s =. (s{firststate)-s{mixed
                d2r =. (r{secondstate)-r{mixed
                d2s =. (s{secondstate)-s{mixed
                first =. w1*(((<r,s){firstcov)+d1r*d1s)
                second =. w2*(((<r,s){secondcov)+d2r*d2s)
                covariance =. (first+second)(<r,s)}covariance
            end.
        end.
        model =. j{::oldmodels
        model =. (<mixed)2}model
        model =. (<covariance)3}model
        model =. interval k_predict model
        likelihood =. 1.0
        if. #measurement do.
            'model d2 loglik s' =. measurement k_update model
            likelihood =. (^((-d2)%2))%((2*PI)*%:m_determinant2 s)
        end.
        models =. models,<model
        likelihoods =. likelihoods,likelihood
    end.
    products =. likelihoods*predicted
    denominator =. (0{products)+1{products
    (<models),<products%denominator
)
imm_estimate =: 3 : 0
    'models mu' =. y

PI =: 3.141592653589793
k_transition =: 3 : 0
    'model t' =. y
    size =. 4
    if. model-:'CA' do. size =. 6 end.
    matrix =. m_identity size
    matrix =. t(<0,2)}matrix
    matrix =. t(<1,3)}matrix
    if. size=6 do.
        matrix =. ((t*t)%2)(<0,4)}matrix
        matrix =. ((t*t)%2)(<1,5)}matrix
        matrix =. t(<2,4)}matrix
        matrix =. t(<3,5)}matrix
    end.
    matrix
)
k_noise =: 3 : 0
    'model t q' =. y
    qt =. q*t
    qt2 =. qt*t
    qt3 =. qt2*t
    size =. 4
    entries =. (0,0,qt3%3),(0,2,qt2%2),:2,2,qt
    if. model-:'CA' do.
        size =. 6
        qt4 =. qt3*t
        qt5 =. qt4*t
        entries =. (0,0,qt5%20),(0,2,qt4%8),(0,4,qt3%6),(2,2,qt3%3),(2,4,qt2%2),:4,4,qt
    end.
    matrix =. (size,size)$0.0
    for_axis. i.2 do.
        for_entry. entries do.
            'first second value' =. entry
            matrix =. value(<(first+axis),second+axis)}matrix
            matrix =. value(<(second+axis),first+axis)}matrix
        end.
    end.
    matrix
)
k_new =: 3 : 0
    'model q measurement' =. y
    size =. 4
    if. model-:'CA' do. size =. 6 end.
    state =. measurement,(size-2)$0.0
    variances =. (2$MeasurementSigma*MeasurementSigma),2$VelocityVariance
    if. size=6 do. variances =. variances,2$AccelerationVariance end.
    covariance =. m_diagonal variances
    h =. (2,size)$0.0
    h =. 1.0(<0,0)}h
    h =. 1.0(<1,1)}h
    r =. m_diagonal 2$MeasurementSigma*MeasurementSigma
    (<model),(<q),(<state),(<covariance),(<h),(<r),(<state),(<covariance),<m_identity size
)
k_predict =: 4 : 0
    model =. 0{::y
    q =. 1{::y
    transition =. k_transition (<model),<x
    noise =. k_noise (<model),(<x),<q
    state =. transition m_vector 2{::y
    covariance =. ((transition m_product 3{::y)m_product m_transpose transition)+noise
    result =. (<state)2}y
    result =. (<covariance)3}result
    result =. (<state)6}result
    result =. (<covariance)7}result
    (<transition)8}result
)
k_innovation =: 4 : 0
    h =. 4{::y
    covariance =. 3{::y
    residual =. x-h m_vector 2{::y
    s =. ((h m_product covariance)m_product m_transpose h)+5{::y
    precision =. m_inverse s
    d2 =. residual m_quadratic2 precision
    (<residual),(<s),(<precision),<d2
)
k_update =: 4 : 0
    'residual s precision d2' =. x k_innovation y
    h =. 4{::y
    r =. 5{::y
    covariance =. 3{::y
    gain =. (covariance m_product m_transpose h)m_product precision
    correction =. (m_identity #2{::y)-gain m_product h
    state =. (2{::y)+gain m_vector residual
    first =. (correction m_product covariance)m_product m_transpose correction
    second =. (gain m_product r)m_product m_transpose gain
    covariance =. first+second
    updated =. (<state)2}y
    updated =. (<covariance)3}updated
    likelihood =. ((-^.2*PI)-(^.m_determinant2 s)%2)-d2%2
    (<updated),(<d2),(<likelihood),<s
)
k_snapshot =: 3 : '2 3 6 7 8{y'
k_smooth =: 3 : 0
    states =. (#y)$<i.0
    last =. (#y)-1
    states =. (<0{::last{::y)last}states
    for_i. |.i.last do.
        current =. i{::y
        following =. (i+1){::y
        gain =. ((1{::current)m_product m_transpose 4{::following)m_product m_inverse 3{::following
        difference =. ((i+1){::states)-2{::following
        state =. (0{::current)+gain m_vector difference
        states =. (<state)i}states
    end.
    states
)

read_inputs =: 3 : 0
    Measurements =: 0$a:
    Times =: i.0
    for_line. }. <;._2 (1!:1 <'input/measurements.csv') do.
        fields =. <;._1 ',',>line
        scan =. (parse_number 0{::fields)-1
        time =. 0.0+parse_number 1{::fields
        point =. 0.0+parse_number&>2 3{fields
        if. scan=#Measurements do.
            Measurements =: Measurements,<0 2$0.0
            Times =: Times,time
        end.
        positions =. (scan{::Measurements),point
        Measurements =: (<positions)scan}Measurements
    end.
    Scans =: #Measurements
    ids =. scans =. i.0
    points =. 0 2$0.0
    for_line. }. <;._2 (1!:1 <'input/truth.csv') do.
        fields =. <;._1 ',',>line
        ids =. ids,parse_number 0{::fields
        scans =. scans,(parse_number 1{::fields)-1
        points =. points,0.0+parse_number&>2 3{fields
    end.
    TargetIDs =: ~.ids
    TargetCount =: #TargetIDs
    TruthExists =: (TargetCount,Scans)$0
    TruthPositions =: (TargetCount,Scans,2)$0.0
    for_i. i.#ids do.
        target =. TargetIDs i.i{ids
        scan =. i{scans
        TruthExists =: 1(<target,scan)}TruthExists
        TruthPositions =: (i{points)(<target,scan)}TruthPositions
    end.
    TargetFirst =: TargetLast =: i.0
    for_exists. TruthExists do.
        indices =. I.exists
        TargetFirst =: TargetFirst,{.indices
        TargetLast =: TargetLast,{:indices
    end.
    for_line. <;._2 (1!:1 <'input/params.txt') do.
        fields =. split_words >line
        key =. 0{::fields
        if. key-:'MODEL' do.
            PrimaryModel =: 1{::fields
            continue.
        end.
        values =. 0.0+parse_number&>}.fields
        select. key
        case. 'Q_CV' do. QCV =: {.values
        case. 'Q_CA' do. QCA =: {.values
        case. 'SIGMA' do. MeasurementSigma =: {.values
        case. 'INIT_VELOCITY_VARIANCE' do. VelocityVariance =: {.values
        case. 'INIT_ACCELERATION_VARIANCE' do. AccelerationVariance =: {.values
        case. 'GATE' do. GateValue =: {.values
        case. 'CONFIRM' do. 'ConfirmM ConfirmN' =: parse_number&>}.fields
        case. 'DELETE' do. DeleteCount =: parse_number 1{::fields
        case. 'ABG' do. ABGCoefficients =: values
        case. 'IMM_Q' do. IMMNoise =: values
        case. 'IMM_TRANSITION' do. IMMTransition =: 2 2$values
        case. 'IMM_INITIAL' do. IMMInitial =: values
        case. 'MATCH_DISTANCE' do. MatchDistance =: {.values
        case. 'OSPA_CUTOFF' do. OSPACutoff =: {.values
        case. 'CONSISTENCY_BOUND' do. ConsistencyBound =: {.values
        case. 'NIS_EDGES' do. NISEdges =: values
        case. 'PLOT_X' do. PlotX =: values
        case. 'PLOT_Y' do. PlotY =: values
        case. 'PLOT_SIZE' do. 'PlotWidth PlotHeight' =: parse_number&>}.fields
        end.
    end.
    PrimaryFilter =: 0
    PrimaryQ =: QCV
    if. PrimaryModel-:'CA' do. PrimaryFilter =: 1 [ PrimaryQ =: QCA end.
    TrackFilters =: TrackObservations =: TrackNIS =: 0$a:
    TrackBirth =: TrackLast =: TrackStatus =: TrackHits =: TrackMisses =: TrackConfirm =: TrackDelete =: i.0
    TrackRows =: <'track,scan,x,y,vx,vy,status'
    AssociationLines =: 0$a:
    ConflictMeasurements =: ConflictTracks =: GreedyDifferences =: 0
    i.0 0
)
track_all_scans =: 3 : 0
    for_scan. i.Scans do.
        live =. I.TrackStatus<2
        measurements =. scan{::Measurements
        number =. #measurements
        if. scan>0 do.
            interval =. (scan{Times)-(scan-1){Times
            for_track. live do.
                model =. interval k_predict track{::TrackFilters
                TrackFilters =: (<model)track}TrackFilters
            end.
        end.
        costs =. ((#live),number)$0.0
        usable =. ((#live),number)$0
        rowgates =. (#live)$0
        columngates =. number$0
        candidates =. 0 3$0.0
        gates =. 0$a:
        for_row. i.#live do.
            track =. row{live
            model =. track{::TrackFilters
            for_column. i.number do.
                innovation =. (column{measurements)k_innovation model
                value =. 3{::innovation
                if. value<:GateValue do.
                    usable =. 1(<row,column)}usable
                    costs =. value(<row,column)}costs
                    rowgates =. (1+row{rowgates)row}rowgates
                    columngates =. (1+column{columngates)column}columngates
                    candidates =. candidates,value,row,column
                    text =. (integer track+1),':',(integer column+1),'=',real value
                    gates =. gates,<text
                end.
            end.
        end.
        assigned =. usable optimal_assignment costs
        greedy =. 0 2$0
        usedrows =. (#live)$0
        usedcolumns =. number$0
        for_candidate. (/:candidates){candidates do.
            'value row column' =. candidate
            if. (-.row{usedrows)*.-.column{usedcolumns do.
                greedy =. greedy,row,column
                usedrows =. 1 row}usedrows
                usedcolumns =. 1 column}usedcolumns
            end.
        end.
        greedy =. (/:greedy){greedy
        equal =. 1
        if. (#assigned)~:#greedy do. equal =. 0
        elseif. -.*/,assigned=greedy do. equal =. 0 end.
        if. -.equal do. GreedyDifferences =: GreedyDifferences+1 end.
        matches =. (#live)$_1
        usedcolumns =. number$0
        for_pair. assigned do.
            'row column' =. pair
            matches =. column row}matches
            usedcolumns =. 1 column}usedcolumns
        end.
        missed =. confirmed =. deleted =. i.0
        for_row. i.#live do.
            track =. row{live
            column =. row{matches
            if. column>:0 do.
                measurement =. column{measurements
                'model nis loglik s' =. measurement k_update track{::TrackFilters
                TrackFilters =: (<model)track}TrackFilters
                observations =. track{::TrackObservations
                observations =. (<measurement)scan}observations
                TrackObservations =: (<observations)track}TrackObservations
                values =. track{::TrackNIS
                values =. ((<row,column){costs)scan}values
                TrackNIS =: (<values)track}TrackNIS
                TrackLast =: scan track}TrackLast
                TrackHits =: (1+track{TrackHits)track}TrackHits
                TrackMisses =: 0 track}TrackMisses
            else.
                TrackMisses =: (1+track{TrackMisses)track}TrackMisses
                missed =. missed,track+1
            end.
            if. 1=track{TrackStatus do.
                if. DeleteCount<:track{TrackMisses do.
                    TrackStatus =: 2 track}TrackStatus
                    TrackDelete =: scan track}TrackDelete
                    deleted =. deleted,track+1
                end.
            elseif. ConfirmM<:track{TrackHits do.
                TrackStatus =: 1 track}TrackStatus
                TrackConfirm =: scan track}TrackConfirm
                confirmed =. confirmed,track+1
            elseif. ConfirmN<:1+scan-track{TrackBirth do.
                TrackStatus =: 2 track}TrackStatus
                TrackDelete =: scan track}TrackDelete
                deleted =. deleted,track+1
            end.
        end.
        processed =. live
        new =. 0$a:
        for_column. I.-.usedcolumns do.
            measurement =. column{measurements
            model =. k_new (<PrimaryModel),(<PrimaryQ),<measurement
            track =. #TrackBirth
            TrackFilters =: TrackFilters,<model
            TrackBirth =: TrackBirth,scan
            TrackLast =: TrackLast,scan
            TrackStatus =: TrackStatus,0
            TrackHits =: TrackHits,1
            TrackMisses =: TrackMisses,0
            TrackConfirm =: TrackConfirm,_1
            TrackDelete =: TrackDelete,_1
            observations =. Scans$<i.0
            observations =. (<measurement)scan}observations
            TrackObservations =: TrackObservations,<observations
            TrackNIS =: TrackNIS,<Scans$_1.0
            processed =. processed,track
            new =. new,<(integer track+1),':',integer column+1
        end.
        conflicts_m =. +/columngates>:2
        conflicts_t =. +/rowgates>:2
        ConflictMeasurements =: ConflictMeasurements+conflicts_m
        ConflictTracks =: ConflictTracks+conflicts_t
        assignments =. greedies =. 0$a:
        for_pair. assigned do.
            'row column' =. pair
            assignments =. assignments,<(integer 1+row{live),':',integer column+1
        end.
        for_pair. greedy do.
            'row column' =. pair
            greedies =. greedies,<(integer 1+row{live),':',integer column+1
        end.
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<emit 'scan';(scan+1);'tracks';(#live);'measurements';number
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<'gate'listed gates
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<'assign'listed assignments
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<'greedy'listed greedies
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<'missed'listed integer&.>missed
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<'new'listed new
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<'confirmed'listed integer&.>confirmed
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<'deleted'listed integer&.>deleted
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<emit 'status tentative';(+/TrackStatus=0);'confirmed';+/TrackStatus=1
        AssociationLines =: AssociationLines,<emit 'conflicts measurements';conflicts_m;'tracks';conflicts_t
        for_track. processed do.
            values =. 4{.2{::track{::TrackFilters
            fields =. (<integer track+1),(<integer scan+1),(real&.>values),<(track{TrackStatus){::StatusWords
            TrackRows =: TrackRows,<','join fields
        end.
    end.
    Evaluated =: I.TrackConfirm>:0
    EvaluatedCount =: #Evaluated
    i.0 0
)
compare_filters =: 3 : 0
    EstimateStates =: (5,EvaluatedCount,Scans,4)$0.0
    SpanMasks =: (EvaluatedCount,Scans)$0
    PrimaryCovariances =: (EvaluatedCount,Scans,2,2)$0.0
    ModelLogs =: (EvaluatedCount,2)$0.0
    HighProbabilities =: (EvaluatedCount,Scans)$0.0
    TrackPaths =: EvaluatedCount$0.0
    LongestGaps =: EvaluatedCount$0
    for_e. i.EvaluatedCount do.
        track =. e{Evaluated
        birth =. track{TrackBirth
        last =. track{TrackLast
        span =. birth+i.1+last-birth
        mask =. Scans$0
        mask =. 1 span}mask
        SpanMasks =: mask e}SpanMasks
        observations =. track{::TrackObservations
        first =. birth{::observations
        for_filter. i.2 do.
            modelname =. filter{::'CV';'CA'
            q =. filter{QCV,QCA
            model =. k_new (<modelname),(<q),<first
            history =. 0$a:
            likelihood =. 0.0
            for_scan. span do.
                if. scan>birth do.
                    interval =. (scan{Times)-(scan-1){Times
                    model =. interval k_predict model
                    measurement =. scan{::observations
                    if. #measurement do.
                        'model nis value s' =. measurement k_update model
                        likelihood =. likelihood+value
                    end.
                end.
                state =. 4{.2{::model
                EstimateStates =: state(<filter,e,scan)}EstimateStates
                history =. history,<k_snapshot model
                if. filter=PrimaryFilter do.
                    covariance =. 0 1{"1 0 1{3{::model
                    PrimaryCovariances =: covariance(<e,scan)}PrimaryCovariances
                end.
            end.
            ModelLogs =: likelihood(<e,filter)}ModelLogs
            if. filter=PrimaryFilter do. primaryhistory =. history end.
        end.
        smoothed =. k_smooth primaryhistory
        positions =. 0 2$0.0
        for_i. i.#span do.
            scan =. i{span
            state =. 4{.i{::smoothed
            EstimateStates =: state(<4,e,scan)}EstimateStates
            positions =. positions,2{.state
        end.
        TrackPaths =: (path_length positions)e}TrackPaths
        'alpha beta gamma' =. ABGCoefficients
        state =. first,4$0.0
        for_scan. span do.
            if. scan>birth do.
